risks.title: Cybersecurity and data protection risks
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned in Item 1A and is a priority for the board of directors. The company has a dedicated CISO with over 25 years of experience and quarterly reporting to the board, indicating significant attention to this area. The nature of the data processed makes this risk potentially high.

risks.title: Macroeconomic uncertainty and inflation
risks.score_rationale: Macroeconomic uncertainty and inflation are described as trends impacting operations in the MD&A section. The language used (inflation fatigue, heightened price sensitivity) highlights the direct impact on consumer behavior and costs. This risk is considered significant by management.

risks.title: Litigation and legal proceedings risks
risks.score_rationale: Item 3 states that the company is involved in various claims and litigation. While management does not expect the current resolution to have a material impact, it acknowledges that there is no assurance future judgments will not be material. This indicates a latent but managed risk.

risks.title: Reliance on real estate leases
risks.score_rationale: Item 2 indicates that the majority of stores and distribution centers are leased under 5 to 10-year leases. While this offers some flexibility, a concentration on leases may present risks related to renegotiations and rent increases.

risks.title: Foreign exchange rate volatility
risks.score_rationale: Financial reports explicitly mention a negative impact from foreign exchange fluctuations of $11.4 million (0.3% of net sales) on consolidated sales for both segments. This indicates direct exposure to currency risk.

risks.title: Competition in the beauty retail sector
risks.score_rationale: The beauty retail sector is inherently competitive. The mention of effective marketing strategies and product assortment innovation suggests the company must continuously adapt to remain competitive.

ai_positioning.summary: SBH does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing
